localChanges: In a game whose rules draw a grid's maps with their own art, other art's Use for that grid in Art and sound is now out of use and says why, rather than doing nothing (closes #1144).

When a game can't be carried over to a new page for a theme's new art, you're now told it goes on as it was and the new art is drawn from the next time the page loads, rather than that a save couldn't be written (#1144).
